newsitem.title: USA: Jacobson chairman retires, successor named.
newsitem.headline: Jacobson chairman retires, successor named.

text.p: Jacobson Stores Inc, which operates 27 stores selling apparel and home furnishings, said Friday that Mark Rosenfeld retired as chairman and chief executive officer, effective today.
Directors have named P. Gerald Mills as his successor, the company said.

Mills retired in 1985 as chairman and chief executive officer of Dayton Hudson Corp's department store division. During the past decade he has been chairman of the board of trustees at Earlham College in Richmond, Ind. He also owned and operated a women's specialty apparel store group in the Indianapolis area.
